name: header-takeover
title: Header takeover
what: A companion to the shared banner: hides (never removes) the header an app names in data-replaces and names the reachable controls that went dark, warns when the banner sits on top of a header nobody declared, hides app copies of controls the banner is really drawing (data-ab-superseded, or automatically in the slot, with data-ab-keep as the written escape hatch), and lets an operator take an app's own control off the band (hide_custom).
link: <script src="{hub}/components/header-takeover/header-takeover.js"></script>  (right after the #app-banner mount, NOT deferred: a declared data-replaces header is then hidden as it is parsed instead of painting once first)

mount.element: #app-banner (the banner's own mount); runs after app-banner:ready

attributes.data-replaces: selector list of the app header(s) the banner stands in for; "" = nothing to replace (silences the detector); absent = detect and warn only
attributes.data-props: optional: the hub's component-properties route for this app (read with ?component=header-takeover)

page_attributes.data-ab-superseded: on an app element or wrapper: the banner already offers this; hidden once the banner has drawn
page_attributes.data-ab-keep: "<why>" on an app control or wrapper in the slot: keep it beside the banner's own; the reason is printed

rules: Hidden, never removed: apps bind their own controls by id at startup.

The declared header never paints first: run during parsing, the component adds a stylesheet rule naming exactly the data-replaces selectors (never html, body, or anything holding the banner), and removes it once the real nodes are marked -- or at DOMContentLoaded when the banner never drew, so a failed banner leaves the app's own header on screen.
The detector only warns; its failure mode is doing nothing.
A duplicate is hidden only while the banner is drawing its counterpart, checked per control and asked twice.
An app's own search box is kept when the standard search bar is not mounted.
hide_custom is a person's decision, reversible on every pass, scoped to the banner's slot.

The drawer keeps one Guided tour, one About this app and one People and Permissions: an app's island copy is hidden while the banner draws its own, and a repeated app row keeps its first copy; each drop is reported.

props.label: Take an app's own control off the band
props.hint: One per line: the words on the control, or its #id. Hidden for everyone on this app; delete the line to bring it back.
